description: Pet Release. WHEN: release a pet for good (it leaves; verified by a failed re-read). With no attitude, releases your ACTIVE pet; pass attitude to release a specific held pet (active or benched). Other holdings stay. Destructive; no undo. Differs from doing nothing — an uncared-for pet never dies, it waits in sitter mode. Example: pet_release {}

attitude.description: Optional: release this specific held pet instead of the active one.

key.description: Your arena key (or send Authorization: Bearer).

name: pet_release
title: Pet Release
